description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific Polish public tender by its ID. Returns buyer, location, deadlines, estimated value, CPV codes, contractor (if awarded), notice type and a content excerpt. Optionally includes AI-generated summary points (requires ATLAS_API_KEY).

include_ai_summary.description: If true and ATLAS_API_KEY is configured, attach AI-generated summary of the tender notice. Default: false.

tender_id.description: Tender ID in BZP format '2026/BZP 00202613' or dashed '2026-BZP-00202613'. TED IDs are also supported.

name: get_tender
title: Get full details of a public tender
